filing_office: Tennessee Secretary of State, Division of Business and Charitable Organizations
filing_fee_notes: Formation costs 50 per member, with a 300 minimum and 3000 maximum. Online payment convenience charges are additional.
registered_agent_rules: Maintain an individual or organization as registered agent with a Tennessee street address; a post office box is not acceptable.
annual_report_due: On or before the first day of the fourth month after the fiscal year closes; April 1 for a December fiscal year-end.
franchise_or_privilege_tax: LLCs generally must register for franchise and excise taxes unless an exemption applies.
unemployment_insurance_agency: Tennessee Department of Labor and Workforce Development
plain_english_summary: Formation and annual reports each have a minimum fee of 300. Franchise and excise taxes are separate obligations.
common_mistake: The annual-report deadline follows the LLC's fiscal year.
notes: Ordinary domestic LLC. The official legacy FAQ lists an annual-report minimum of 300 and maximum of 3000; additional current annual-report surcharges were not confirmed. Formation instructions confirm the fiscal-year deadline. Name-reservation fee, name-search URL, annual-report filing URL, processing time, expedited service, publication requirement and operating-agreement mandate were not confirmed.
